item.title: Vicki Lammon, owner of Vicki’s Lunch Van, passes away
item.description: The owner of a well-known burger restaurant in Montgomery has died.

item.title: Montgomery County Sheriff Derrick Cunningham named National Sheriff of the Year
item.description: Sheriff Cunningham was chosen from more than 3,000 sheriffs nationwide.

item.title: Trojans prep for 2026 campaign
item.description: In his fourth season at Troy, Head Coach Eric Newell is optimistic heading into the 2026 season.

item.title: Alabama names next Offensive Line Coach
item.description: Alabama adds Adrian Klemm to its coaching staff as the next Offensive Line Coach.

item.title: Savannah Guthrie posts message to her mother’s kidnapper asking to provide proof she is alive
item.description: NBC “Today” show host Savannah Guthrie said Wednesday that her family is ready to talk to people holding their 84-year-old mother, but they want to see proof that she is alive.

item.title: State lottery bill filed in the Alabama legislature
item.description: The bill does not specify where the funds would be allocated.

item.title: Uniontown Police Department launches new website
item.description: The website is designed to keep the community in the know about what is happening at the police department.

item.title: Montgomery Man Shot While Working; Court Records Show Suspect Was Out On Bail
item.description: Court records show the suspect is currently out on bail in a separate case in which he is accused of shooting a 36-year-old man in the leg on Coliseum Boulevard in December 2024.

item.title: MPS launches pilot program aimed at students’ emotional health
item.description: The Life Be Life-ing App helps students build resilience, confidence and emotional strength.
